old-bridge.notes: Township states garbage is privatized; residents choose a private hauler and no municipal curbside trash schedule is published. MCIA provides bi-weekly single-stream recycling (6:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m.; leave cart at curb if missed). 2026 schedule linked from recycling-information page (town-hosted PDF via https://5il.co/3symt). MCIA missed pickup: 800-488-6242 / mciarecycling@mciauth.com; township recycling office ext. 6107 / recycling@oldbridge.com. ASL 95-gallon carts required where delivered.

perth-amboy.name: Perth Amboy

schedules.area_note: NORTH SIDE (Areas above the Conrail train tracks). The Conrail train tracks serve as the official boundary separating the North and South sections of the city for trash collection scheduling. If a holiday falls on your regularly scheduled garbage collection day, service will resume on the next scheduled collection day.
SOUTH SIDE (Areas below the Conrail train tracks). Same Conrail boundary. Holiday: resume next scheduled collection day.

perth-amboy.notes: Official Recycling & Garbage Collection and Recycling Guidelines pages do not state collection days on the municipal site; they embed a third-party my-waste.mobi schedule widget and link to a '2021 Guidelines Recycling Sanitation' PDF that returned HTTP 404 when fetched from the city site (not used). No 2026 town-hosted trash or recycling day schedule found on perthamboynj.org. Trash weekly days taken from city-hosted Holiday Annual Guidelines PDF labeled 2025 that states REGULAR HOUSEHOLD GARBAGE COLLECTION SCHEDULE (treated as permanent weekly days; PDF also lists Jan 1 2026 holiday). Curbside recycling weekday not stated as plain text on fetched municipal pages (my-waste widget / Recycle Coach only); recycling schedule left null. FLAG: trash source_date 2025.

dropoff.hours: Tuesday and Thursday 2:00 p.m.–8:00 p.m. (gates close 7:45 p.m.); Saturday 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. (gates close 4:15 p.m.); closed Sun–Mon and Wed–Fri; closed on holidays falling on Tue or Thu

piscataway.notes: Household trash is private-hauler only (no municipal trash weekday). Recycling via MCIA; 2026 map PDF boundaries transcribed. Township states household trash is collected by private haulers retained by residents; no municipal trash day schedule published. Curbside recycling is MCIA single-stream in 95-gallon ASL carts. Mini-Dump requires Service Card; kitchen garbage, paint, and other listed items not accepted at Mini-Dump.
